public_rationale: Part of the claim holds. In November 2024 ChatGPT still tended to fabricate rather than decline. A Tow Center audit found it 'would sooner conjure a response out of thin air than admit it could not access an answer'; it admitted uncertainty only 7 times in 200 queries. The 'as strong as ever' part is not supported as written. OpenAI reported that GPT-4 scored 40% higher than GPT-3.5 on its adversarial factuality tests. Elsewhere in the same post Marcus concedes that hallucinations 'may have declined'. The tendency persisted, but measured rates appear lower than at launch.
limitations: The improvement figure is OpenAI's own internal test.
The Tow Center audit covers source attribution only.
The anecdote in the post cannot be checked independently.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: ChatGPT's tendency to generate fabricated content is as strong as ever in 2024.

statement.excerpt: A trustworthy AI, not having seen the film, would have declined the mission, and not just made things up. But not ChatGPT, which never hesitated. Its tendency to generate bullshit is as strong as ever.

from_speaker: A trustworthy AI ... would have declined
our_interpretation: Two parts. (a) ChatGPT in 2024 tends to make up an answer rather than decline when it lacks the information. (b) This tendency is 'as strong as ever', meaning no weaker in 2024 than at launch in late 2022.
'Bullshit' is read as fabricated or unfounded content (hallucination).
Target period: ChatGPT's launch (2022-11-30) to the post date, because the claim compares 2024 with earlier versions.
The film-review anecdote cannot be checked independently and is not scored.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence that 2024 ChatGPT still fabricates confidently and rarely declines, and that its fabrication rates are no lower than earlier versions'.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Evidence that ChatGPT's measured fabrication or hallucination rates fell substantially between the 2022 launch model and 2024 models, or that 2024 ChatGPT often declines when it lacks information.
